errors.text_span: categorized by the retrieval method employed
errors.evidence: The chart is categorized by the dataset (HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, etc.) on the x-axis, not by the retrieval method. The retrieval methods (NoR QA, OneR QA, IRCoT QA) are the different series within each category group.

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis displays the names of four retrieval methods: HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis displays four datasets, not four retrieval methods.
The vertical axis scale ranges from 0 to 40, not 5 to 35. The values of the bars fall within this range, but this is not the range of the axis itself.

errors.text_span: The value axis is labeled "Number of Questions with Factual Errors,"
errors.evidence: The vertical axis in the figure has no label. The chart title is "Factual Errors".

errors.text_span: the scale begins at 15 and extends to 29
errors.evidence: This describes the approximate range of the data values, not the axis scale. The y-axis scale clearly starts at 0 and extends to 40.

errors.text_span: red, orange, and blue, representing OneR QA, NoR QA, and IRC-T QA, respectively
errors.evidence: The mapping order is incorrect. The legend shows orange corresponds to NoR QA and red corresponds to OneR QA. The description reverses this pairing.

errors.text_span: the blue bar for OneR QA
errors.evidence: According to the legend, blue bars represent IRCoT QA, not OneR QA.
The bar for IRCoT QA is dark blue, not purple.

errors.text_span: for IRC-T QA reaches a height of 15
errors.evidence: There is no bar for the IRCoT QA series with a value of 15. The values for IRCoT QA are 5, 14, 23, and 11.

The description completely fails to mention that the chart uses a grouped bar structure, where for each dataset on the x-axis, there are three bars representing the three different QA methods. This is a critical structural element of the chart.
